product_overview: IOTARU is a public-facing website for an integrated IoT solutions company, showcasing products, solution offerings, blog content, and a contact path for prospective customers. It helps visitors explore smart security, monitoring, and automation capabilities across home, office, and city use cases.
core_goals: Browse the company’s IoT solutions and understand their benefits
Explore the product catalog and view individual product details
Read technical blog articles and IoT guides
Find contact information and submit an inquiry
Navigate the site smoothly on desktop and mobile devices

features.name: Global Navigation
features.description: Visitors can move between the main sections of the site using the shared navigation on desktop and mobile.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click navigation links -> View the selected site section
Navigate to / -> Open mobile hamburger menu -> Click a navigation link -> View the selected site section
Navigate to / -> Open mobile hamburger menu -> Close mobile menu -> Stay on the current page

features.name: Global Loading Preloader
features.description: The homepage displays a loading preloader before the main hero content becomes available.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Wait for preloader to dismiss -> See the homepage hero content

features.name: Solutions Overview and Detail Pages
features.description: Visitors can review solution categories and open individual solution pages to learn about Smart Home, Smart Office, and Smart City offerings.
user_flows: Navigate to /solutions -> Scroll through grid cards -> Click solution card to view details -> See the selected solution page
Navigate to /solutions -> Scroll through grid cards -> Click solution card to view details -> Review solution benefits and included components

features.name: Products Catalog and Product Detail Pages
features.description: Visitors can browse the product catalog and open individual product pages to review specifications and descriptions.
user_flows: Navigate to /products -> Browse the product catalog -> Click product card to view details -> See the selected product page
Navigate to /products -> Browse the product catalog -> Click product card to view details -> Review product specifications and features

features.name: Blog Listing and Blog Posts
features.description: Visitors can explore technical articles and open individual posts for IoT guidance and educational content.
user_flows: Navigate to /blog -> Browse the article list -> Click blog post to read more -> See the selected article page
Navigate to /blog -> Browse the article list -> Click blog post to read more -> Read the full article content

features.name: Contact Inquiry Form
features.description: Visitors can open the contact page and submit an inquiry to reach the company.
user_flows: Navigate to /contact -> Fill in contact details and message -> Submit the contact form -> See the contact submission path
Navigate to /contact -> Enter incomplete contact information -> Submit the contact form -> See validation feedback

features.name: Navigation
features.description: Global navigation via navbar and mobile menu

features.description: Preloader blocking display until hero is loaded

features.description: Solutions page showing grid of offerings
